note: Primitive camping at a Gasconade River access: a gravel loop and lot ringed with barrier posts, the camping spot in the timber at its east edge, a privy, picnic area and boat ramp. The river is about 45 m away through the bank trees, with a big gravel bar opposite. No tables at the sites, no water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed, stays under the lot rule: MDC names 'individual primitive camping sites' in the page text and marks a Primitive Camping Area (map symbol + GIS point) at the loop. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy written; phone matches; pin on the GIS point. Riverview stands.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): page: 'Facilities and features include individual primitive camping sites, privy, boat ramp, and picnic area'; 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. The map (11/07) legend has Primitive Camping Area, Privy, Boat Ramp, Parking Lot, Disabled Accessible and draws the camping symbol between the loop road and the river next to the ramp. GIS layer 27: one point at 37.90343,-92.28499 = stored pin; lots at 37.90355,-92.28555 (51 m) and 37.90319,-92.28595 (88 m, ADA). On the leaf-off frame there is a gravel loop about 90 m long with a gravel lot edged by barrier posts; the camping point is at the lot's east edge where the timber starts; individual pads are not distinguishable. 12.8 acres.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview stands): from the camping point it is about 45 m to the Gasconade's bank through leaf-off timber, no road between; the ramp track runs down to the water just south. Not an open apron, so not riverfront; the river and the gravel bar opposite show through the trunks on the leaf-off frame. In leaf the view is unproven - no photos read.
PIN: on the GIS point at the lot's east edge. No move.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) stands. River bottom; floods with the Gasconade.
